zones.title: Refer
zones.body: AR-14 builds the UUI; the refer goes to the OpenAI call with the UUI as a Refer-To query parameter. No call id on the session means the call was never accepted through AR-51.

zones.title: Outcome
zones.body: Sent or failed is logged with the target; the tool answer tells the model what to say.

panels.title: AR-55 Refer call
panels.body: Risk 1 and 2 of decision doc 13 in one call: does the REFER reach the carrier, and does the query parameter in Refer-To survive. AR-53 answers both from what Twilio posts.
